task: A strategically located border city that serves as the primary gateway for trade between two rival powers has petitioned for expanded self-governance. The city's merchant council argues that its unique position requires flexibility in tariffs, legal codes, and diplomatic representation that a distant central government cannot provide. Granting autonomy would likely increase trade revenue and reduce administrative burden, but it would also create a precedent that other prosperous cities might follow, potentially eroding central authority. The rival power has signalled that it would view the city's autonomy as an opportunity to expand its own influence there. Design a governance framework for the border city that grants sufficient flexibility to maximise its economic function while preserving its political loyalty and preventing foreign co-option.

Unforced-intent note: this task spans every substantive domain the framework must bound — tariffs/trade revenue (hubu), legal-code flexibility (xingbu), diplomatic representation (libu_ritual), anti-co-option security (bingbu), political-loyalty staffing (libu_personnel), and economic infrastructure (gongbu) — plus the drafting/review/execution machinery (zhongshu / menxia / shangshu). The recalled precedents reward frameworks that tie *each* sensitive domain to an explicit office with numeric thresholds and tripwires, so engaging the full set is substantive here, not filler. Recording all nine, each with a distinct responsibility.

[CIVAGENT_DISPATCH_PLAN]
{"dispatches":[
{"office":"zhongshu","order":1,"responsibility":"Draft the border-city autonomy charter: enumerate granted flexibilities (tariffs, local legal codes, trade-level diplomatic representation), reserve sovereignty and treaty-making to the centre, and embed sunset authority plus explicit escalation links."},
{"office":"hubu","order":2,"responsibility":"Design bounded fiscal flexibility: capped tariff bands the city may adjust, revenue-share ratio with the centre, customs audit tripwires, and budget/debt controls to block debt-based foreign capture."},
{"office":"xingbu","order":3,"responsibility":"Define bounded legal jurisdiction: civil/commercial cases the city may adjudicate under merchant custom versus crimes, capital cases, and matters involving rival-power subjects reserved to central courts."},
{"office":"libu_ritual","order":4,"responsibility":"Bound diplomatic representation: permit trade protocol and consular courtesy only, reserve envoy accreditation and treaty-making to the centre, and set reporting rules for all rival-power contacts to blunt influence expansion."},
{"office":"bingbu","order":5,"responsibility":"Guarantee loyalty and defence: central garrison under command separate from the merchant council, numeric limits on the city watch/militia, and tripwires against militia capture or foreign military presence."},
{"office":"libu_personnel","order":6,"responsibility":"Secure political loyalty through staffing: central appointment and fixed-term rotation of the chief magistrate and key officers, loyalty assessments, and bars on dual office or client ties to the rival power."},
{"office":"gongbu","order":7,"responsibility":"Control strategic infrastructure: standardise weights, measures and market facilities, and require central approval for land sales, construction and fortification to prevent foreign acquisition of gate assets."},
{"office":"menxia","order":8,"responsibility":"Review and audit the integrated charter: exercise seal-and-reject over any grant breaching thresholds, and codify standing audits plus automatic tripwire reviews across the fiscal, legal, diplomatic, debt, land and militia domains."},
{"office":"shangshu","order":9,"responsibility":"Coordinate execution: dispatch the approved framework to the six boards with explicit offices, numeric thresholds, reporting lines and an integrated adjustment cycle so economic autonomy stays inside a centrally controlled skeleton."}
]}
[/CIVAGENT_DISPATCH_PLAN]
